name: intro
content: This plugin uses the UK government's **Fuel Finder** open data service. You need your own API credentials: register (free) at the [Fuel Finder developer portal](https://www.developer.fuel-finder.service.gov.uk/fuel-finder/public-api) using a GOV.UK One Login, then create API credentials to get a client ID and secret.

name: clientId
label: Client ID
help: The client ID issued by the Fuel Finder developer portal.

name: clientSecret
label: Client secret
help: The client secret issued by the Fuel Finder developer portal.

name: importNote
content: All UK fuel stations (~8,100) are imported, refreshed hourly with current prices. Scope dashboards to the stations you care about, or use the latitude/longitude parameters on the data streams to filter by distance.
